label: LNMIIT Smart Healthcare Stream
info: Node-RED flow streaming Raspberry Pi sensor readings (Temperature, Ultrasonic HC-SR04, Force FSR) to the LNMIIT Smart Healthcare Web Application.

name: README: Raspberry Pi Hardware -> Node-RED -> Backend Live Monitoring
info:
LNMIIT SMART HEALTHCARE HARDWARE SENSORS INTEGRATION

1. Sensors Connected to Raspberry Pi:
   - Temperature Sensor: LM35 / DS18B20 (°C)
   - Ultrasonic Sensor: HC-SR04 Distance (cm)
   - Force Sensor: FSR Bed Pressure (N)

2. Target Endpoint: POST http://<SERVER_IP>:5000/api/iot/vitals
3. Header: x-api-key: lnmiit_nodered_secure_key_2026
4. Method: POST
5. Content-Type: application/json

Data streamed to this endpoint updates the Doctor Live Monitoring page instantly via WebSockets (Socket.IO).
